notes: Fixed the kanban/assertion-ledger seam: bin/managent status/board and next now read docs/infra/assertion-ledger/assertions.jsonl. A row whose latest assertion (last line per object wins, append-only) carries meta.status=closed supersedes tasks.json's status in BOTH directions — it renders under done with an (asserted: A<id>) marker and its live claim (agent identifier + dispatched_to) is suppressed, and next never hands it out. The eight rows named in the brief now render correctly: T430/T432/T433/T434/T435/T436/T439 (tasks.json dispatchable, asserted closed A0005-A0011) and T440 (tasks.json in_progress claude-opus-5, asserted closed A0012) all appear under done (asserted); the dispatchable section no longer lists them and no phantom claude-opus-5 seat is shown. Scope decision: ONLY meta.status=closed supersedes tasks.json here. The other ledger statuses (dispatchable/in_progress) are left to the doctor per assertion-ledger spec 9.3 — e.g. T369 (tasks.json done, A0016 in_progress), T443 (tasks.json done, A0014 dispatchable), T452 (tasks.json in_progress, A0017 dispatchable) are disagreements this seam deliberately does not pick a winner for, because flipping those would contradict recorded verdicts. Regression (tools/regression-managent-ledger-board-seam.sh, wired into zig build test) was written TEST-FIRST and shown RED against the pre-fix binary: arm A (dispatchable + closed -> done asserted), arm B (in_progress + closed -> done asserted, no live claim), arm C (next refuses to hand out a closed-asserted row when it is the only dispatchable seed), arm D (null: no ledger file -> rendering and next unchanged). All four arms green post-fix; tools/smoke.sh PASS; bin/managent deployed (stamp ff495e5-dirty). Observation (pre-existing, not caused by this row): the first guarded build embedded a stale version stamp (a7b30e7) even though tools/gen-version.sh had regenerated src/version.zig; a second rebuild produced the correct stamp. The version module appears to be cached across builds — worth a look if resume self-check/stale-deploy reports look wrong after a one-shot build.
